extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors (especially new editors attempting to create a page)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who attempt to create a new Wikipedia article: checks to run before creating a page, account/permission requirements, and troubleshooting steps if a title is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing or alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Trump inauguration jokes" in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for the title in existing articles to ensure the topic isn't already covered under a different name or spelling before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New users must have an account and meet autoconfirmed status (Wikipedia's threshold) before they can create articles; otherwise use alternate submission routes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), follow the article wizard process or request creation so experienced editors can review and assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate inbound links to discover if related content exists or if a redirect would be appropriate; linked pages can indicate existing coverage or preferred article location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created page visibility delay / purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created page doesn't appear, allow time for replication or use the purge function to force an update before concluding it doesn't exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create redirects from alternative capitalizations or spellings to the canonical article title to aid discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log for removed pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log and relevant deletion discussion to learn why a prior page was removed and whether recreation is appropriate or what fixes are needed.
